scope: A fixed replayed Zapdos/Marowak endgame with three revealed Zapdos moves and one occupied unknown slot. Enumerate all 39 remaining move names from the native format learnset at level 50, excluding duplicate Thunderbolt, Sleep Talk and Hidden Power. Sources include Generation 1/2 machines and level moves; the three retained moves are machine/tutor moves and introduce no egg/event compatibility dependency. Native team validation and every public-prefix/own-action check are performed by the unchanged census harness; the certificate harness separately replays all 38 alternatives and checks logs and observers. Stats, items, occupied move count, current sleep duration and all other state are fixed; the full game information set is not covered. One common Rock Slide priority supplies the family lower bound. A fixed precommitted Sleep Talk/Sleep Talk/Hidden Power Ice opponent sequence in the limiting world supplies an upper bound against all own first actions and adaptive later replies. Fixed policies depend only on decision count and legal actions. Partial enumeration and horizon leaves keep [0,1] bounds. Ledger arithmetic and every policy action are checked independently. Rest certificates are reused without rewriting their historical hashes; Hyper Beam certificates reproduce exactly. These are conditional security values, not a prior-weighted win rate. Positive per-world losses are initial-action certificates assuming optimal subsequent play. Changing the initial action is not a uniform improvement: it provably sacrifices value in some worlds. No production change, human calibration, wall-time speed claim or deployed-bot superiority claim.
